messages:
jordan_csm: Heads-up — Harborview Transit Authority confirmed two new groups to onboard: Rider Experience (search + realtime FAQs) and Compliance (records classification + retention). aiming for phased rollout next month.

priya_success: Nice. Renewal for this account is ~9 weeks out. Strong expansion signal if we can meet timeline :eyes: 

marco_se: Do we have details on ingestion size? embeddings vs chat? Any PII concerns from transit ops?

jordan_csm: They plan large embeddings ingest (route guides, maintenance logs), chat for operator assist, and a compliance pipeline to flag sensitive PII in reports. Current baseline qps ~30, expecting weekday peaks ~450-700 qps depending on events.

ken_eng: That peak needs planning. They asked for Private with KMS and audit trails, plus on-prem logs for retention. Private provisioning ~3-4w. Recommend temporary Hosted burst + a small Dedicated pilot to bridge.

laila_sales: Procurement will want SLA and key management proof. If we present a clear migration path and timeline, contract upsell to Dedicated or Private should be straightforward.

marco_se: Quick sketch (not final):
```json
{"hosted_burst": {"max_qps": 700, "duration_weeks": 3, "models": ["embed-stable-v1","assistant-lite"]}, "dedicated": {"gpus": "2xA10G","baseline_qps": 250}}
```
Estimate hosted burst cost: ~2.5k-6k USD/week depending on token profile.

ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-21901 — harborview-onboard-expansion. Assigned: eng-infra, security-review.

ken_eng: Infra tasks: - measure current model footprint, prepare quantized variants - template canary routing (start 5%) - precompute embedding dedupe + cache TTLs to reduce regen cost

priya_success: I'll schedule an enablement/security sync Wed 9am PT. Jordan — can you invite Harborview PM + their security lead?

jordan_csm: On it. Procurement blockers logged: KMS-backed keys, full audit logs, retention proof for records.

marco_se: Short-term mitigations: incremental ingest windows, dedupe pass, light quantization. I'll drop a one-pager.

laila_sales: If pilot goes well, suggest 9-12 month term for Dedicated to improve unit price. I'll draft amendment language.

ken_eng: Timeline recap: Hosted burst can be live <24h; Dedicated ~4-6 business days depending on inventory; Private VPC + KMS ~3-5w with security review.

priya_success: ACTIONS: - infra (ken/marco) -> temp Hosted burst spec + Dedicated config by EOD Thu - enablement (priya) -> invite + playbook by Mon - sales (laila) -> contract amendment draft by next Wed - csm (jordan) -> confirm Harborview preferred start date and security contacts

ops-bot: CS-21901 updated: status -> provisioning_plan_written

jordan_csm: Thanks all — will update Harborview and loop back with security contact. :pray:
